front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered garage and a long covered patio sit in a fenced yard, with a new driveway running down the side to reach them. Inside, wood-look floors run from the front door to the Kitchen, where navy cabinets and stone-look counters surround a stainless range. Cullinan Park is under a mile away.

back.title: The Yard, the Plan and the Neighborhood
back.planNote: The Primary Bedroom sits at the back of the house, with its bath beside it. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies room sizes.
back.roomIntro: Every room is on one floor, with the living areas up front and the bedrooms along the hall behind them. The Primary sits at the back of the house. The covered patio and garage sit out in the yard. Sizes are approximate and come from the listing.

photo0.name: Rear of the House
photo0.text: From the back of the lot, the rear of the home shows the same new Hardi Plank siding as the front. The covered patio runs along the side of the house, next to the garage.

photo1.name: Covered Garage
photo1.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover a plank-walled space with a concrete floor. An 8'11" x 25'11" patio sits alongside it, in the fenced backyard behind the house.

claim.text: The lot has never flooded, and a wide concrete walk leads from the street to the covered porch. A new driveway runs down the side to the covered garage out back. The yard is fenced. New flooring and lighting carry through every room. Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road is under half a mile away.
claim.head: What is new

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room sizes are approximate. Living area per HCAD.

photo2.name: Entry
photo2.text: A curved staircase with an iron railing rises from the entry, and a powder bath is down the hall. The study sits just off the entry hall, with built-in shelves. The foyer is 4'9" x 11'1" on the plan.

top.title: Living Opens to Dining and the Kitchen

lead.name: Living Room
lead.text: A wide cased opening joins the Living Room to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so one room reads straight through to the next. A tall double-pane window faces the front yard, and a long clerestory window set high on the wall adds natural light and keeps the street out of view. Wood-look flooring runs through from the front door with no threshold.

side.name: Kitchen
side.text: An L with a peninsula, navy lower cabinets and white shaker uppers. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, with a full-height stone-look backsplash behind it. The pantry is close by. All of it is new. Two pendant lights hang over the breakfast bar.

side.name: Breakfast Nook
side.text: A large double-pane window brightens the nook. A door gives direct access to the backyard. It opens to a small deck, with steps down to the fenced yard. The Kitchen sits right beside it, with the Dining area a few steps beyond. A gold light hangs above it.

row.name: Craftsman Door
row.text: The Craftsman-style front door has a divided-light window and opens from the covered porch straight into the Living Room. Wood-look flooring starts at the threshold.

row.name: Dining Area
row.text: One open run reaches from the Dining area to the front door, with the Living Room on one side and the Kitchen on the other. A sputnik-style light hangs over the table.

row.name: Breakfast Bar
row.text: A stone-look counter on the peninsula seats a row of barstools under a pair of pendants. The Dining area is right next to the bar, so the cook stays part of the whole room.

bottom.title: A Vaulted Primary at the Back of the Home

lead.name: Primary Bedroom
lead.text: The only vaulted ceiling in the house sits over the Primary, with an exposed painted beam running its length. Windows on two walls bring in natural light, and a double-door closet opens beside the doorway to the bath. The room sits at the back of the home, well away from the street. A short hall leads back toward the Dining area and the Living Room.

side.name: Primary Bath
side.text: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top with a matching backsplash, on a dark navy vanity with drawers. The shower is tiled floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a sliding glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld on a slide. All of it is new.

side.name: Hall Bath
side.text: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile floors and a window. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door, with room for towels. Everything in it is new. Its window sits high on the wall.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves above hold bins and luggage. A doorway nearby leads to the Primary Bath.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, with windows on two walls facing the neighborhood. Natural light reaches the room from two sides, across the front yard.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: A large window brings in natural light, and the reach-in closet sits beside the door. That leaves the window wall free for a desk. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary.

jl.front9: A 1940 East End bungalow with three bedrooms, two full baths and 1,385 square feet, redone from the foundation up. The wiring, plumbing, roof and Hardi Plank siding are new, and so are the floors, the lighting, the kitchen and both baths. Out back, a fenced yard holds a covered patio and a covered garage, and the house has never flooded. The foundation was leveled and braced, and the fence and driveway are new.
jl.front11: A 1940 East End bungalow with three bedrooms, two full baths and 1,385 square feet, redone from the foundation up. The wiring, breaker box, plumbing, roof and Hardi Plank siding are new, and so are the floors, the lighting, the kitchen and both baths. The Primary sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling, and a fenced yard holds a covered patio and a covered garage. The foundation was leveled and braced, the fence and driveway are new, and the house has never flooded.

js.front9: I just helped sell 2614 Calder Street, a 1940 East End bungalow redone from the foundation up, with new wiring and a new roof. If you have been thinking about selling, I can tell you what your home could bring in today's market and show you what sold nearby. There is no cost to ask.
js.front11: I just helped sell 2614 Calder Street, a 1940 East End bungalow redone from the foundation up, with new wiring, plumbing and a new roof. If you have been thinking about selling, I can tell you what your home could bring in today's market and show you what sold nearby. There is no cost to ask, and the numbers are yours to keep.
